Added `specs/pair-remote-agents/design.md`, recording why remote support in `mngr pair` is shaped the way it is: the unison version-interop rules that force a version check rather than a presence check, why a version check is still not enough (no Debian or Ubuntu package ships the `unison-fsmonitor` that continuous sync needs on the far side, so mngr's own agent image falls through to the install), why the SSH transport goes through a generated wrapper instead of `-sshargs`, and why the initial git reconciliation fetches from the agent rather than into it.
